title: How LLMs influence computer vision
reading: The slide illustrates how large language models are reshaping computer vision by presenting the architecture of a typical multimodal LLM: an image passes through a vision encoder whose features are fed, alongside a text prompt, into a large language model that produces a natural-language answer. The worked example asks where a tower building is in an image, and the model (attributed to OpenAI GPT-4o) replies with a detailed grounded description identifying the Texas A&M water tower bearing 'WELCOME TO AGGIELAND', placed slightly left of center in the foreground with Kyle Field behind it.

visuals.description: Pipeline schematic: input image -> Vision Encoder -> Large Language Model, with a Text Prompt also entering the LLM; output is the descriptive answer text shown at right.
visuals.assertion: A typical multimodal LLM couples a vision encoder to an LLM so that visual features and a text prompt jointly produce a language response.

visuals.description: Example GPT-4o response text describing the Texas A&M water tower and Kyle Field.
visuals.assertion: The model can localize and identify objects in an image with contextual, world-knowledge-rich language.
